name: devanagari-dha
draw: Devanagari letter dha (ध): a curled loop on the left joined to a tall vertical stem, with the headline above the stem only.

name: devanagari-na
draw: Devanagari letter na (न): a short curved stroke on the left joined by a low horizontal bar to a vertical stem, under a headline.

name: devanagari-pa
draw: Devanagari letter pa (प): a u shaped cup whose left arm is short and right arm is a full vertical stem, with the headline over the stem only.

name: devanagari-pha
draw: Devanagari letter pha (फ): the pa cup and stem with a small curl hooking off the right side of the stem.

name: devanagari-ba
draw: Devanagari letter ba (ब): a closed round loop joined to a vertical stem with a small diagonal stroke inside the loop, under a full headline.

name: devanagari-bha
draw: Devanagari letter bha (भ): an open cup with a small inner curl on the left joined to a vertical stem, with the headline over the stem only.

name: devanagari-ma
draw: Devanagari letter ma (म): a u shaped cup joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a full flat headline.

name: devanagari-ya
draw: Devanagari letter ya (य): a u shaped cup with a small inward hook at the top left joined to a vertical stem, with the headline over the stem.

name: devanagari-ra
draw: Devanagari letter ra (र): a short curled stroke like a small hooked 2 hanging from a short headline, with no stem.

name: devanagari-la
draw: Devanagari letter la (ल): a curled 3 like stroke on the left joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a full headline.

name: devanagari-va
draw: Devanagari letter va (व): a closed round loop on the left joined to a vertical stem on the right, under a full headline.

name: devanagari-sha
draw: Devanagari letter sha (श): a curled loop on the left with a short slanted stroke, joined to a vertical stem under a headline.

name: devanagari-ssa
draw: Devanagari letter ssa (ष): a u shaped cup crossed by a diagonal stroke and joined to a vertical stem, under a full headline.

name: devanagari-sa
draw: Devanagari letter sa (स): a curled hook on the left joined by a short bar to a vertical stem on the right, under a headline.

name: devanagari-ha
draw: Devanagari letter ha (ह): a curled stroke like a 3 with a tail flicking right at the bottom, hanging from a headline, with no stem.

name: devanagari-ksha
draw: Devanagari letter ksha (क्ष): the conjunct ksha: a looped ka like shape with a crossing curl joined to a vertical stem, under a headline.

name: devanagari-tra
draw: Devanagari letter tra (त्र): the conjunct tra: the ta shape with a small slanted stroke joining its vertical stem near the foot.

name: devanagari-gya
draw: Devanagari letter gya (ज्ञ): the conjunct gya: a zigzag ja shape fused to a curled stroke and a vertical stem, under a headline.
